```sql
WITH ranked_salaries AS (
    SELECT 
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS age, 
        e.gender, 
        s.salary, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.birth_date, CURDATE()), e.gender ORDER BY s.salary, e.emp_no) AS rn, 
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.birth_date, CURDATE()), e.gender) AS cnt 
    FROM 
        employees e 
    JOIN 
        salaries s ON e.emp_no = s.emp_no 
    WHERE 
        s.from_date <= CURDATE() AND s.to_date > CURDATE()
), median_calculation AS (
    SELECT 
        age, 
        gender, 
        salary 
    FROM 
        ranked_salaries 
    WHERE 
        rn IN (FLOOR((cnt + 1) / 2), FLOOR((cnt + 2) / 2))
)
SELECT 
    age, 
    gender, 
    AVG(salary) AS median_salary 
FROM 
    median_calculation 
GROUP BY 
    age, 
    gender 
ORDER BY 
    age, 
    gender;
```
